key_insight: An interpretable deep-learning workflow for tissue-based neural autoantibody assays improved reader interpretation, especially for less-experienced readers.
clinical_relevance: This approach may help standardize autoimmune encephalitis antibody screening by reducing reader-dependent variability in tissue-based assay interpretation.
method: Trained on 2,357 retrospective serum and CSF images from >80 institutions
Prospective validation on 200 unique patient images with expert-consensus reference labels
Two experts and two novices read cases unaided, then with AI assistance after a 2+ week washout
evidence_signal: In prospective validation, the standalone classifier reached AUC 0.922, and AI-assisted pooled reader accuracy rose from 90.4% to 97.4% with a large specificity gain.
watch_item: Results came from centralized-lab images and need broader multicentre, cross-platform validation before routine deployment.
paper_title: AI-Assisted Tissue-Based Antibody Interpretation in Autoimmune Encephalitis: Prospective Validation and Reader Study
